enchantments.tooltip: +15 Enhancement Bonus: +15 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Sovereign Vorpal: Passive: +0.5[W] damage dice.On Vorpal Hit: If your target has fewer than 3000 Hit Points, they are instantly slain. If your target has above 3000 Hit Points, they take 300 damage.
Poisonous 6: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to drip with a vile venom, dealing 6d6 poison damage on each hit.
Twining Hemlock: This weapon is poisoned with a deadly strain of flowering plant. Hits by this weapon have a chance of putting your foe to sleep.
Wounding 3: This weapon saps the health from your enemies, dealing 3 Constitution damage on each hit.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
